measurement_notes.item: lid-close freeze during the FP32 round
measurement_notes.detail: CX_MAIN_01 in the FP32 round contains a 745.1 s gap between adjacent frames (machine frozen while the lid was closed); latency from that run is void
measurement_notes.action: CX_MAIN_01 was re-run cleanly under FP32; result identical failure keys
